hints.title: Set Bit Counting
hints.text: Count the number of 1s in the binary representations of integers a and b using popcount or bit_count.

hints.title: Score Branching Condition
hints.text: Compare s1 and s2 where s1 is set bits of a and s2 is set bits of b.

hints.title: Integer Division Rule
hints.text: If s1 >= s2 return s1 * s2, otherwise compute floor division s2 // s1.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```python
def calculateScore(a: int, b: int) -> int:
    s1 = a.bit_count()
    s2 = b.bit_count()
    if s1 >= s2:
        return s1 * s2
    return s2 // s1
```

complexity.notes: Hardware popcount instruction executes in constant time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Looping through bit strings repeatedly adds unnecessary overhead.
